dedupe_keys.name: airportsdata airport location and timezone database

description: airportsdata is an open database of location and timezone data for nearly every airport and landing strip in the world, distributed as a Python package and a CSV file. It holds 28,298 entries keyed by ICAO code (with pseudo-ICAO identifiers for fields without one), including 7,884 IATA codes and 12,614 US FAA location identifiers, with name, city, subdivision, ISO country code, elevation, the latitude and longitude of the airport reference point and an IANA timezone. New submissions are validated against national aeronautical information publications, the ARINC database, IATA or ch-aviation before publication, and the project is a fork of mwgg/Airports. Coverage is global. Access: free under the MIT licence, as a CSV on GitHub or the Python package on PyPI (version 20260905). Caveats: there is no history (closed airports are removed), heliports and seaplane bases are excluded unless they have an IATA code, elevation is often wrong, and accuracy cannot be guaranteed. It supports building airport nodes for air network models, geocoding flight records and hazard exposure screening of airports, and complements OurAirports and the Upply airport list catalogued here.
